title: herdr-peers research claims ledger (claims-v1)
description: One lane's claims, filed next to its report and read by `herdr-peers debate claims`. Keys are matched across lanes case-insensitively, after the lead's --map of synonyms. Producers may add keys within a schema version; consumers must ignore unknown keys.

lane.description: The filing pane (w1:p4) or a lane name; one ledger per lane.

vendor.description: The lane's model vendor, for the coverage report; dropped by --anonymous.

sources.description: path:line, a command, or a source with the date read.
